decision.authorityLocation: before the fixed bootstrap kernel, use an ephemeral published-candidate resolver: a candidate is eligible only when its own WORKBOARD repository identity matches and its active branch equals the published ref containing it; validate exact predecessor identity and Git ancestry; remove candidates superseded by another eligible candidate that names them as exact immediate predecessor; accept exactly one maximal candidate and bind to its exact ref/SHA, otherwise fail closed
decision.defaultAlignment: a provider default may be aligned to the current route as a compatibility/discovery pointer after current authority is known, but never becomes route authority
decision.singleValue: one durable mutable semantic value has one canonical origin owner, and that owner must expose exactly one current semantic value; derived projections, exact-bound caches, explicitly historical/as-of statements, independent evidence and validation constraints remain non-authoritative
decision.D0018Repair: reclassify the stale pre-production Status vocabulary as explicitly historical/as-of without changing D0018 product/runtime semantics or erasing its prior state
